laws.rule: Takamatsu City bans smoking in designated busy areas, such as Chuo-dori and the central shopping arcades, except at the city's outdoor smoking spots and places with fixed ashtrays. Outside those areas, people without an ashtray nearby or a portable one are asked not to smoke. The city's page lists no fine.

laws.rule: Kagawa Prefecture has no accommodation tax. At the governor's press conference of 16 June 2025 he said it was still undecided and under study with municipalities; two Shodoshima towns and Kotohira Town had said they were considering their own. Check the prefecture's pages for later decisions.

laws.heading: 香川県青少年保護育成条例, curfew for young people
laws.rule: Kagawa's Kagawa Youth Protection and Development Ordinance (香川県青少年保護育成条例), art. 15. The ordinance sets the late-night period as 11 pm to 4 am. A guardian must make sure that a young person (generally under 18) who goes out in that period is accompanied by the guardian or by an adult the guardian asks, unless there is a necessary reason. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The penalty clause for others was not extracted here. Yen at A$1 = JPY 110.82 (RBA, 30 Oct 2026).

festivals.what: Setouchi Triennale (瀬戸内国際芸術祭): a contemporary art festival held every three years on islands and ports of the Seto Inland Sea. The 2028 edition has three sessions: spring 14 April to 28 May, summer 25 July to 20 August, autumn 29 September to 12 November 2028 (117 days, each session with one weekly day off). All sessions: Naoshima, Teshima, Megijima, Ogijima, Shodoshima, Oshima, Inujima, Takamatsu Port and Uno Port (Uno is in Okayama Prefecture). Spring only: Seto-Ohashi, Shido and Tsuda, Hiketa. Autumn only: Honjima, Takamijima, Awashima, Ibukijima, Utazu.
